d: Great temple dedicated to the sun with ara and simulacrum of the same. Cosroe, Siroe and Medarse.
Emira in man's dress with the name of Idaspe and sayings.
Inside room of Cosroe with coffee table and chair. Siroe with sheet.
Cosroe, Siroe aside and then Laodice.
Emira under the name of Idaspe and sayings.
Siroe, then Emira under the name of Idaspe.
Land apartments corresponding to 'garden with chairs. Siroe without sword and Arasse.
Cosroe, Emira with the name of Idaspe and sayings.
Arasse, then Emira with Guards and no swords.
Closed and enclosed in the castle destined for prison in Siroe. Siroe, then Emira.

Great square of Seleucia with view of the royal palace and with magnificent apparatus ordered for the crowning of Medarse that then serves for that of Siroe. In the opening of the scene there is a mix between the rebels and the Royal Guards, who are strengthened and flee. Cosroe, Emira and Siroe one after the other, with bare sword, in Arasse with the whole People; Cosroe defending himself from some Conjured, falls.
